timestamp_semantics: Monotonic logical append time after the Campaign276 final validated state; not a market-data or host-wall-clock measurement.
objective: Freeze a finite priority-ordered catalog of economically independent issuer external-state mechanisms before any Campaign277 targeted prior-definition or source-frontier search.

catalog_selection_rule.selection_method: After this file is immutable, inspect complete local terminal-definition and source-frontier evidence in catalog priority order. Select the first route that is economically independent, has a lawful and auditable 2019-2023 point-in-time issuer identity, availability, revision and complete-market denominator contract, and is not a same-mechanism source, entity-role, jurisdiction, formula, field, window or cohort rescue. Close every sibling and parameter variant. If no route survives, terminalize Campaign277 before formula, direction, provider, fields, source rows, factor values, comparison values, prices or returns.
